message: I’ve always believed that a little preparation goes a long way, especially when it comes to being on the road. I recently came across some great tips on car emergency preparedness that really got my inner over-prepared person excited! 🚗 It's all about making sure you have what you need for those unexpected moments—like a trusty emergency kit or knowing what to do if your car breaks down. What’s one thing you keep in your car just in case?
